subject.title: feat: adopt shared design system across ClawHub UI

question: Should ClawHub allow this stacked design-system PR to proceed before @openclaw/design-system is installable by CI/Vercel and reviewers can inspect the posted visual proof?
rationale: The code direction is plausible, but the private dependency currently blocks automated validation and the proof assets are not independently viewable, which is a maintainer-owned merge safety choice rather than a narrow code repair.

options.title: Fix access before merge
options.body: Make the design-system package and proof assets accessible to CI/Vercel and reviewers, then rerun the normal gates before landing the stack.

options.title: Accept private dependency risk
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally merge while owning the blocked CI, preview, and fresh-install consequences until credentials or package visibility are configured.

options.title: Pause until stack lands
options.body: Leave this PR open behind the upstream design-system stack and refresh it after the base PRs are merge-ready.

recommendation.title: Fix access before merge
recommendation.body: Make the design-system package and proof assets accessible to CI/Vercel and reviewers, then rerun the normal gates before landing the stack.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick owns the current stacked design-system migration and appears in recent current-main UI/style history for the affected surfaces.
